source.name: UN OHCHR database of business enterprises involved in Israeli settlement activities (A/HRC/60/19)
source.note: All 158 enterprises from Annex I of A/HRC/60/19 (26 September 2025). Activity letters refer to paragraph 96 of A/HRC/22/63: (a) construction supply, (b) surveillance equipment, (c) demolition equipment, (d) security services, (e) services/utilities to settlements, (f) banking/financial operations, (g) natural resources use, (h) waste dumping, (i) market captivity, (j) settler-owned reinvestment. Annex II (7 enterprises no longer involved) is intentionally excluded.
